title: Inconsistency
body: Two reviewers read an ambiguous clause differently. The same claim gets approved for one employee and rejected for another.

title: No audit trail
body: A status is stamped with no record of which clause justified it. The moment an auditor asks why, the answer is gone.

title: Language exclusion
body: Field staff ask “ye claim allowed hai kya?” in Hindi or Marathi, not English. Most policy PDFs are English-only.
